tickets.title: Obtain Velvet Acorn lapse remediation details
tickets.text: Obtain from Velvet Acorn Life Insurance the reinstatement terms, catch-up premium, conversion availability, and any underwriting requirements for Arlo Copperwisp's $1.5 million term life policy that entered grace or lapse status after a premium draft failed from the closed Pocket Lantern Bank account.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain that carrier information by March 1, 2024.

tickets.title: Obtain current property and casualty declarations
tickets.text: Obtain current home, auto, umbrella, and rental property declarations pages from Polka Fern Insurance Agency so the latest renewal coverage limits can be confirmed for the Copperwisp household, including the Portland primary residence and the Bend rental condo.
tickets.evidence: Current declarations are needed by March 8, 2024.

tickets.title: Review Bend rental condo protection coverage
tickets.text: Review Bend rental condo protection covering landlord, tenant, liability, property loss, and loss-of-rent exposures for the Copperwisp household, including the $635,000 condo purchased in January 2024 with expected gross rent of about $3,200 per month before a 10% property management fee.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review that protection by March 15, 2024.

tickets.title: Compare Moonbadger benefits with private coverage
tickets.text: Compare Moonbadger Robotics supplemental life, disability, and beneficiary election options with the household's private coverage for Arlo Copperwisp before the benefits portal closes, including the $1.5 million Velvet Acorn Life Insurance term policy and Lena's $6,500 monthly Coral Badger Insurance disability policy.
tickets.evidence: That comparison is needed by March 5, 2024.

tickets.title: Obtain Velvet Acorn beneficiary evidence
tickets.text: Obtain current carrier evidence on the Velvet Acorn Life Insurance beneficiary arrangement for Arlo Copperwisp's $1.5 million term policy to reconcile with the beneficiary summary retained in the Cloudberry Kite Custody planning file before finalizing the protection review.
tickets.evidence: That evidence is needed by March 12, 2024.

tickets.title: Collect estate planning documents and summarize gaps
tickets.text: Request Arlo and Lena Copperwisp's current estate planning documents, organize received files, and prepare a concise gap summary for advisor review. Include wills, revocable trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designation evidence, trust funding records, and any recent attorney correspondence. Do not provide legal interpretation; identify document dates, named roles, missing pages or signatures, and items that may require attorney confirmation. The 2016 Buttonwood Balloon Legal binder names Lena as Arlo's primary agent and Jules Copperwisp as successor trustee; the binder lacks trust funding evidence and fiduciary role information may not reflect the current household and insurance beneficiary structure.

subTasks.title: Request and log estate documents
subTasks.text: Send the standard document request checklist to Arlo and Lena Copperwisp and log each received item by document type, execution date if visible, and file location.

subTasks.title: Review completeness and role information
subTasks.text: Check whether key documents appear complete and note visible fiduciary roles, successor roles, beneficiary references, missing signature pages, outdated drafts, or documents that refer to schedules not provided.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor gap summary
subTasks.text: Summarize collected evidence, open questions, and attorney follow-up items for the lead advisor before any client-facing recommendations are discussed.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to collect the estate planning documents by March 22, 2024.
